title: Claim 127.3064: census at the shipped config (depth 6, evicting dict28.o), executed-count prices, Markov trap census, success p5=0.5935

claims.statement: For nonidentity Q in BLS12-381 G2 and uniform z in GT, compute g=e(P0,Q) and recover x with z=g^x by a Frobenius-class rho walk in GT, returning [x]P0 verified by e(P,Q)=z. CLAIM. Smallest n/10000 with 20000*2^(n/10000) >= W, exact integer check, n-1 asserted to fail; W is the exact sum of nine rows. CENSUS AT THE SHIPPED CONFIG. Depth 6 (not 5), the shipped evicting dictionary dict28.o called through ctypes with call counters asserted nonzero (not a Python dict), the shipped key routine state_key48w on twelve 4-word field lanes; 320 and 320 fixtures at the two scales, 209/320 and 208/320 successes; eviction loss MEASURED against dict28_nolru.o at the same config: 15346 evictions, 0 records evicted before match, 2478 matches at report, control 15524 drops. Worker count: measured at 8,64,128 (trail 7-170); production declares 1024 and its trail is 9.36e34, which no fixture reaches - the partition series at fixed S is reported instead of asserting 1024. SUCCESS. 5th percentile of 10000 bootstrap draws of min(census A, census B) x retention = 0.5935 (median 0.6316), above the 0.39 floor; the v27 independently-uniform residual divisor is deleted. ADDRESSING. Nine-word slots, 128-bit ref field, 127-bit slot refs; slot = mulhi128(hash, cap) from four 64x64 products with a carry chain, so cap above 2^64 routes; sparse test exercises slots above 2^64. EXECUTED WORK. MUL_CHARGE 47924 = executed f12mul (loop-free, gcov executed per call equals the static span), 887.48 Ir per Fp multiply; state_key48w 2224, dict28_lookup 606, dict28_insert 516 are MAX executed counts over census traffic and the worst path; the v27 'or True' is replaced by equality asserts. STEP 39878.595 Ir. TRAP. Ring 6. Short families (length <= 6) contribute EXACTLY zero: under ring 6 no slot repeats inside a window and a single occurrence cannot have a vanishing kappa sum (W(1)=0). Long families (7..12) are bounded from the extended observer at depth 6: period<=12 windows over 7680000 steps with 0 admissions, rate <= 3/N (stated independence hypothesis), charged 5.82e+31 windows x 32 x STEP. The rule-of-three line is deleted from the code. Survival is claimed at one scale only (rp=521041, 400 pairs, gap-1 0.995).
